rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an aspiration or dream, especially a personal life or career aim.

example.english: My aspiration when I was young was to become a doctor.
example.traditional: 我細個嘅理想係做醫生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 lei5 soeng2 hai6 zou6 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use this when the aspiration is framed as a concrete goal to work toward rather than a lofty dream.

example.english: My aspiration this year is to earn a professional licence.
example.traditional: 我今年嘅目標係考到專業牌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 haau2 dou2 zyun1 jip6 paai4

rows.note: Choose this when the aspiration is mainly a heartfelt wish or something the speaker strongly hopes to fulfil.

example.english: My greatest aspiration is to take my mum on a trip.
example.traditional: 我最大嘅心願係帶阿媽去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 sam1 jyun6 hai6 daai3 aa3 maa1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for a lofty ambition or a serious aim, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: My aspiration is to serve the community.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 pou5 fu6 hai6 fuk6 mou6 se5 wui6
